advice: Abstain. The supplied full512 kernel and panel32 helper already map four ZA.S tiles to the four 32×32 output quadrants, with each tile updated once per ordered K step. The wrapper changes only disjoint output bands, so it cannot alter tile reuse. A distinct remapping needs generated-body or layout/traversal changes, which are not specified by the supplied evidence.
risks: The prior panel32 experiment passed correctness but did not pass promotion gates; its joint outcome does not measure tile reuse. Do not infer a tile-level speedup from it. Any future remapping needs full-GEMM correctness checks, including general sizes and tails, and fresh paired controls under unchanged settings.
